function.name: smpg_help
function.description: Agent discovery tool: explains how to use SMPG, available content choices (AI/JSON/DB), background choices (AI/plain/custom), and API key configuration.

function.name: smpg_generate_post
function.description: Generate an aesthetic social media carousel or reel post with typography and dark cinematic backgrounds without needing a browser.

topic.description: Core topic, vibe, or message to generate content about (e.g. 'Stoic discipline under pressure')

contentSource.description: Source of quotes: 'ai' (Gemini), 'json' (direct quotes array), 'db' (local curated database)

quotes.description: Optional explicit list of quotes when contentSource is 'json'. Requires ZERO API key.

bgType.description: Visual style: 'ai' uses Flux generator, 'plain' uses solid dark color, 'custom' uses your own image

bgColor.description: Hex color code when bgType is 'plain'

imageUrl.description: Direct image URL when bgType is 'custom'

imagePath.description: Local file path when bgType is 'custom'

fontProfile.description: Typography style for the quote overlay

function.name: smpg_run_workflow
function.description: Execute an advanced declarative SMPG workflow specification JSON object.

workflow.description: The complete workflow object conforming to smpg.workflow schema

function.name: smpg_manage_config
function.description: Store or check Gemini API key inside the app configuration so you don't need to supply it every time.

apiKey.description: API key string to save (required when action is 'set')
